headline: Galaxy posted a $323M third-quarter profit this morning, bitcoin is holding just under $80,000 as the Fed's two-day meeting begins, and wallet maker Keystone is destroying almost 19,000 devices after a breach.

stories.title: Galaxy reports a $323M quarterly profit as crypto earnings week begins
stories.summary: Galaxy, the crypto financial firm run by Mike Novogratz, reported a $323M profit for July to September before the US market opened today, after a loss the quarter before. Most of the profit came from its own investments and its new AI data center business rather than crypto trading. Robinhood reports after today's close, and Coinbase and Strategy on Thursday.
points: Net income was $323M, up from a loss of $85M in the second quarter, per Galaxy's results release.
Its data center business earned $79M in adjusted gross profit (up 293%), the first full quarter of rent from its Helios site leased to CoreWeave, per Galaxy.
Galaxy finished its earlier $200M share buyback on 15 Oct, and its board approved a new buyback of up to $200M on 26 Oct, per Galaxy.
Robinhood reports after the close today with a call at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Wed Bangkok), per its announcement.
Coinbase and Strategy both report after the close on Thursday 29 Oct, with calls at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Fri Bangkok), per their announcements.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds just under $80,000 as the Fed's meeting begins
stories.summary: Bitcoin is sitting just below $80,000 as the Fed starts a two-day meeting; its decision comes Wednesday afternoon US time, and a hold is widely expected. US bitcoin funds took in money on Monday, while options traders are paying up for protection against a drop. A large batch of bitcoin options expires on Friday.
points: Bitcoin was about $79,625 on Tuesday morning, 8.7% below its October high of about $87,200, per The Block.

US spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) took in a net $110.34M on Monday 26 Oct, all of it into BlackRock's IBIT, ending two days of outflows, per SoSoValue data reported by TokenPost.
94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect the Fed to hold rates on Wednesday, and all 100 expect a hike in December, per Kitco.
Bitcoin options worth about $12.2B expire on Deribit on Friday 30 Oct, with 'max pain' at $79,000, as of 17 Oct per CryptoTicker. Max pain is not a price target.

stories.title: Wallet maker Keystone will destroy almost 19,000 devices after a breach
stories.summary: Hardware wallet maker Keystone says an attacker broke into its website and stole a factory key used to prove its devices are genuine, so fake devices could pass its online check. It is destroying unsold stock and pausing shipments. Customer names and addresses were exposed, but Keystone says no seed phrases or private keys were.
points: 18,835 unsold devices will be destroyed and shipments are suspended, per CoinDesk.
25,964 buyer records from 2024 to 2026 were exposed, including names, contact details, addresses and orders, per CoinDesk.
The attacker got in on 20 Oct through a flaw in a third-party monitoring tool, per CoinDesk.
Keystone says no seed phrases or private keys were exposed, per CoinDesk.
Leaked addresses make fake 'recall' emails and texts likely: never type your seed phrase into anything you were sent.

briefs.title: Ripple wins final approval for a US national trust bank
briefs.summary: The OCC gave Ripple final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank, which will oversee the reserves behind its RLUSD stablecoin and offer custody; a trust charter does not allow deposits or lending, per The Block.

briefs.title: More big companies object to tokenized copies of their stock
briefs.summary: IBM, Oracle, Intel and IonQ objected to the OKX-ICE venue offering tokenized versions of their shares, bringing the reported total to 26 of 63 targeted companies, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Kraken's parent to run regulated markets on Hyperliquid
briefs.summary: Hyperliquid says Payward, Kraken's parent, will be the first CFTC-regulated deployer of its HIP-3 markets, a possible route to regulated US perpetual futures; it still needs regulatory approval, per The Block.

briefs.title: ARK buys Circle shares as the stock drops 7%
briefs.summary: ARK Invest bought about $5.2M of Circle stock on Monday, the day Circle shares fell 7.1% to close at $79.84, per The Block.

briefs.title: Japan's top yen stablecoin falls short in its first year
briefs.summary: JPYC reached only about a quarter of its first-year target, with 3.2B yen (about $20M) in circulation; its CEO blames a 1M-yen daily issuance limit, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: NBA signs CFTC prediction-market agreement
briefs.summary: The NBA is the third league after MLB and the NHL to sign with the CFTC, and named Kalshi and Polymarket as preferred exchanges, per The Block.
